statement: ∀ q : ℚ, q ≠ 0 → ∃ (d : ℤ) (u : ℚ), q = (p : ℚ) ^ d * u ∧ u ∈ R p ∧ u⁻¹ ∈ R p
proof:
classical
intro q hq
have hp := h_H001.1
have hcarrier := h_T007.2.2.1.1
letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
obtain ⟨a, ha, hpa⟩ := (padicValRat.finite_int_prime_iff.mpr (Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hq)).exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd
obtain ⟨b, hb, hpb⟩ := (padicValRat.finite_int_prime_iff.mpr (show (q.den : ℤ) ≠ 0 by exact_mod_cast q.den_ne_zero)).exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd
have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by intro hh; simp [hh] at ha; exact (Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hq) ha
have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by intro hh; simp [hh] at hb; exact q.den_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hb)
refine ⟨(multiplicity (p : ℤ) q.num : ℤ) - (multiplicity (p : ℤ) (q.den : ℤ) : ℤ), (a : ℚ) / b, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· have hnum : (q.num : ℚ) = (p : ℚ) ^ multiplicity (p : ℤ) q.num * a := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hden : (q.den : ℚ) = (p : ℚ) ^ multiplicity (p : ℤ) (q.den : ℤ) * b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  rw [zpow_sub₀ (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero), zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, ← Rat.num_div_den q, hnum, hden]
  ring
· exact (hcarrier _).mpr ⟨a, b, hpb, rfl⟩
· apply (hcarrier _).mpr
  refine ⟨b, a, hpa, ?_⟩
  simp [inv_div]
